relationships.subject: anti-CGRP monoclonal antibodies
relationships.evidence_quote: Delayed local skin reactions-appearing 24 to 48 h after subcutaneous injection-such as erythema, induration, pruritus, and pain, have been reported in patients receiving anti-Calcitonin Gene-Related Peptide monoclonal antibodies (anti-CGRP mAbs).

relationships.subject: tolerance protocol
relationships.evidence_quote: With the use of the protocol, all three were able to continue treatment, with symptoms either markedly reduced or fully resolved.

key_findings: A four-step tolerance protocol (antihistamine, topical corticosteroid, abdominal injection, NSAID, cold compress) let three patients continue anti-CGRP mAbs despite delayed skin reactions.
